purpose: Resumable activity and verified context reconstruction after interruption.
use: Resuming after interruption, crash or context loss: reconstruct verified context and actual effects before continuing.
semantic_conditions: Summaries are navigation only; never replay non-idempotent work blindly.
mandatory_preconditions: Owned checkpoint, actual effect observations and current freshness.
postconditions_verification: Context rehydrated and remaining action re-authorized before dependent effects.
